title: Choose the visual world for your training site
question: The roll assigned Anatomy Atlas. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Anatomy Atlas
options.thesis: Every exercise is a numbered plate: the moving figure, its muscles keyed in atlas colours, the form cues as its legend.
materials: atlas colour key (muscle red, vein blue, nerve yellow)
options.viewport: A workout page opens on Plate 1: the animation large and framed, 'Feel' muscles keyed beside it in muscle red, plate number + sets×reps as the caption, cues numbered underneath.
options.risk: Can tip into clinical; with no muscle drawings, the colour key alone carries the anatomy.

raised.raise: Exercise status (anchor / new / optional) is a mark on the plate number (solid, ringed, dashed), never colour alone.
The plate you were on is flagged and reopened when you come back to the phone mid-workout.
Session phases (warm-up, working sets, finisher) read as labelled bands; colour is never the only signal.

options.label: Machine Placard
options.lineage: instruction decals bolted to commercial gym machines
options.thesis: Each exercise as the placard on the machine: big numbered steps, a framed figure, the target muscle in red.
options.viewport: Black placard band per exercise: steps 1-2-3 at large scale, the animation in a bolted window, red muscle chip.
options.risk: The most familiar of the set: it sits close to the dark fitness-app look most runs land on.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding
options.thesis: The workout as a concourse: a yellow band always shows the exercise you're on and what's next.
options.viewport: Sticky yellow band '2 · Inverted rows → next: Band pull-aparts'; animation below; cues as one-line sign messages.
options.case: Beats the atlas on mid-set clarity (one decision at a time, readable at arm's length); loses on identification.
options.risk: Yellow everywhere tires on the long research pages.

options.label: Normalled Jackfield
options.thesis: Exercises as numbered lanes tied to defaults by amber link lines.
options.viewport: Numbered amber lanes on black, one per exercise.
options.case: Loses both axes: a configuration metaphor for a reading task.
options.kept: State drawn by mark, not hue.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.thesis: Exercises as frames strung on a perforated rail.
options.viewport: A frame strip of the session's exercises.
options.case: Loses both axes: editing ritual, not training ritual.
options.kept: The place you stopped is flagged on return.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.thesis: The session as a lighting cue sequence from dark to day.
options.case: Loses both axes: atmosphere over instruction.
options.kept: Labelled phases; colour never the only signal.

options.label: Monochrome Product
options.thesis: Every claim paired with a screenshot that proves it.
options.viewport: Claim / proof pairs down the page.
options.case: Loses both axes: a sales page grammar for a personal manual.
options.kept: Every cue sits beside its figure.

options.label: Curved Crease
options.thesis: Content ruled by one sweeping arc.
options.viewport: A folded sheet with plate-numbered figures.
options.case: Loses both axes: no link to training.
options.kept: Figure and legend stay paired as one unit on small screens.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean fitness-app reference, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Exercise cards with thumbnail, sets×reps chip, expandable cues.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every workout app by design.
